summary: In 2.6 the operator creates Routes and configures CSRF automatically; with external ingress you configure CSRF on the ingress, and controller CSRF UI settings no longer affect the platform gateway. The settings table maps Subscription to the gateway and System, Job, Logging and Troubleshooting to controller.
questions: How is CSRF configured for AAP on OpenShift?
Controller CSRF settings have no effect in AAP 2.6
CSRF errors with external ingress for platform gateway
Which settings apply to controller and which to the gateway?
